name: local-job-match
description: Myanmar-first marketplace connecting customers with local experts.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ljm/shared && npm run build -w @ljm/api && npm run build -w @ljm/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @ljm/api" "npm run dev -w @ljm/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ljm/api && npm run test -w @ljm/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && npm run typecheck -w @ljm/api && npm run typecheck -w @ljm/web
